name: Registry Extractor
description: A development tool that walks a running modpack's registries and writes everything it can observe about the loaded content to a single JSON file. Run /extract <file path> from a client in a world. Spaces in the path work without quoting, a leading ~ expands to your home directory, and a directory path gets registry.json appended. Not a gameplay mod: the output feeds the Unofficial Integrated Dynamics Docs and Tools project as typed game data.
